description: List invoices (Rechnungen): number, type, status, customer, date, due date, net/tax/gross, paid, sent/locked state, web link. Filters: status (draft = Entwurf, open = offen, partially_paid, paid = bezahlt), type (invoice RE, advance AR Abschlagsrechnung, partial TR, final ER, cancellation SR Stornorechnung, reminder MA Mahnung, recurring WKR), contactId, exact number (Rechnungsnummer), date range, overdueOnly (open/partially paid past the due date, überfällig). overdueOnly, type and number are checked here too (up to 1,000 rows scanned per call; total left out, filteredLocally set). A cancelled invoice keeps status paid; its SR invoice has cancelsInvoiceId. Page with offset = nextOffset while hasMore. Use detail=summary to browse/find. Use sevdesk_invoice_get for positions, tax and payment terms.

contactId.description: Only invoices of this contact (id from sevdesk_contacts_search).

detail.description: Use summary to browse/find; full (default) or the matching get tool for details.

from.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging: pass the previous result's nextOffset.

overdueOnly.description: Only open/partially paid invoices past their due date (Berlin time).

to.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).

type.description: Invoice type: invoice (RE), advance, partial, final, cancellation, reminder…

name: sevdesk_invoices_list
title: List sevDesk invoices
